condition: High-risk (massive) pulmonary embolism 6 days after major surgery
permutationLabel: Obstructive shock, thrombolysis contraindicated (surgery 6 days ago)
summary: 66-year-old man, day 6 after open Hartmann's procedure: sudden collapse, SBP 78, HR 132, SpO₂ 86% on 15 L oxygen, dilated RV on bedside echo — thrombolysis contraindicated by recent major surgery.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Sudden collapse and breathlessness on the ward
inputs.hpi: Day 6 after open Hartmann's procedure for perforated sigmoid diverticulitis. Collapsed on the way to the toilet, now severely breathless and clammy. Enoxaparin 40 mg prophylaxis since day 1; missed two doses for an epidural catheter removal.

exam.general: Grey, clammy, confused. HR 132, BP 78/50, RR 32, SpO2 86% on 15 L non-rebreather, T 37.2°C. JVP raised.
exam.abdomen: Stoma pink and healthy. Wound clean. Abdomen soft.

imaging.name: Bedside echocardiogram
imaging.result: Dilated, hypokinetic right ventricle, RV:LV ratio >1, septal flattening. No pericardial effusion.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: High-risk pulmonary embolism with obstructive shock — day 6 after Hartmann's procedure
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: High-risk (massive) PE with obstructive shock and RV dysfunction, 6 days after major abdominal surgery (contraindication to systemic thrombolysis). UFH; surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed therapy; critical care.

mustInclude.knownGapNote: iOS CI 2026-09-25 (run 36169134350, database mode): no management item matched among 15 (ios.pipeline.decisions, ios.pipeline.actions, ios.radiation.plan, ios.radiation.followUp, ios.soap.plan)

mustExclude.note: Major surgery 6 days ago is a contraindication to systemic thrombolysis (ESC 2019); an unqualified thrombolysis order is a bleeding hazard — prefer surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed therapy.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Qualify the alteplase medication and key point with the ESC 2019 contraindications (major surgery within 3 weeks) and put surgical embolectomy / catheter-directed therapy first when the patient is post-operative.

mustExclude.note: Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: 2019 ESC guidelines — acute pulmonary embolism
guideline.section: High-risk (haemodynamically unstable) PE: UFH and systemic thrombolysis; surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed treatment when thrombolysis is contraindicated or has failed; recent major surgery (within 3 weeks) is a contraindication to thrombolysis (table of contraindications)
guideline.citation: Konstantinides SV, Meyer G, Becattini C, et al. Eur Heart J. 2020;41:543–603.

rationale: Permutation of the post-operative PE seed: high-risk PE where the reperfusion choice is changed by recent surgery. Tests emergency level, shock alarm, reperfusion, critical care and that thrombolysis is not offered without the contraindication.
